name: Phantom
description: A rogue subclass that adds the Phantom tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Wails from the Grave
grants.description: After dealing Sneak Attack damage, choose another creature within 30 feet; it takes Necrotic damage equal to half the Sneak Attack dice. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

grants.name: Whispers of the Dead
grants.description: After a Short or Long Rest, gain one skill or tool proficiency of your choice until you use this feature again.

grants.name: Tokens of the Departed
grants.description: When a creature dies nearby, use your Reaction to capture a soul trinket, up to your Proficiency Bonus at once. A trinket improves death and Constitution saves and can fuel Wails from the Grave or a question to the spirit.

grants.name: Ghost Walk
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, become spectral for 10 minutes, gaining a 10-foot Fly Speed and Hover while attacks against you have Disadvantage. Once per Long Rest, or destroy a soul trinket to repeat it.

grants.name: Death's Friend
grants.description: Wails from the Grave also damages the original Sneak Attack target, and you gain one soul trinket whenever you finish a Long Rest without one.
